The '''Dwelling Circle''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kegan/Legends|Kegan]]. Many [[Keganite]]s lived within the Circle. Like most Circles in the city of Kegan, it was connected to other Circles in a ring surrounding the [[Gathering Circle]] at the city's center.<ref name="TFFT">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Fight for Truth]]''</ref>

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Dwelling Circle may be another name for the [[Living Circle]].
